expert_term.en: expert appointed by a judicial authority (term in common use; the statutory definition was not verified)

questions.summary_en: The appointment decision specifies the task, powers, report deadline, hearing and authorised urgent measures.

items_en: Statements, supplied evidence and technical analysis
One report for multiple experts, recording each differing opinion and its reasons

rights_duties.summary_en: An expert not enrolled on the expert roll takes the prescribed oath before the assigning court or judge, recorded in the case file. Obstacles or a needed extension of the task are referred to the court.

procedures.scope: Federal civil and commercial evidence law, Federal Decree-Law 35/2022. Criminal procedure and the separate DIFC/ADGM court regimes are not covered by these provisions.

esignature.law_local: المرسوم بقانون اتحادي رقم (46) لسنة 2021 بشأن المعاملات الإلكترونية وخدمات الثقة
esignature.law_en: Federal Decree-Law 46/2021 on Electronic Transactions and Trust Services, articles 18 and 20

timestamp.qualified_recognition: Qualified time requires the statutory qualified service, a UTC-linked clock and tamper-evident binding, with the provider and service meeting UAE requirements. An RFC 3161 token or EU-qualified service is not automatically UAE-qualified. Article 18(3) gives qualifying signatures handwritten-signature effect, subject to the law and implementing regulation.

open_questions: Federal Law No. 7 of 2023 Regulating Expertise before Judicial Authorities: registration of experts, duties, prohibitions, the expert's oath formula, disciplinary penalties and any criminal penalty are unverified. Not confirmed whether it repealed Federal Law No. 7 of 2012.

Federal Decree-Law No. 38 of 2022 (Criminal Procedure Law): articles on the use of experts by judicial police, the Public Prosecution and the courts, the expert's oath before the prosecutor or court, and report requirements are unverified.
Federal Decree-Law No. 31 of 2021 (Crimes and Penalties Law): the article(s) punishing a false expert opinion or report, and the maximum penalty, are unverified.

No UAE national adoption or official guidance on ISO/IEC 27037/27041/27042/27043 or ISO/IEC 17025 for digital forensic reports was verified (Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology / UAE standards; Dubai Police and Abu Dhabi Police forensic laboratory requirements).
Legal family 'mixed' (civil law with Islamic law elements) is a general classification, not taken from a cited source.
Appointment and recusal requirements under the federal expert law, detailed electronic-evidence rules, and current emirate-specific expert forms require further review.

The Arabic terminology and current implementing regulation, UAE trust-list status and foreign-service recognition conditions must be checked before claiming qualified-signature or timestamp status. TDRA's English translation is for reference; Arabic prevails.
